notes.title: 03/08 Skill Refresh and Balance Adjustment
notes.content:
[h1]Challenge Mode: Skill Re-selection[/h1]
Reduce the luck factor of random skills in Challenge Mode.
This allows players to focus on constructing builds that clear levels more quickly using a limited set of skills.
Therefore, the skill re-selection feature has been added to Challenge Mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/bbd76755ced66da64031ac68f6a3da4ca1602e56.gif[/img]
(In Normal Mode, skills are unlimited across multiple playthroughs, so this re-selection feature is not available.)

[h1]Skip Tutorial[/h1]
Although in Normal Mode (from the second playthrough onward) and in Challenge Mode the tutorial is automatically skipped,
considering that when starting a new save file the tutorial stage still needs to be played even if it has been completed before,
the "press and hold F to skip the tutorial" feature has been added to the early part of the tutorial level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/0a10f782e3234df8159378d2ee94108a14641a46.jpg[/img]
(Nevertheless, we still hope that new players will play through the tutorial stage at least once.)

[h1]Skill Balancing[/h1]
1. Explosive Arrow – Explosive Spread  
Adjusted the mechanism of explosive spread. Now, the initial spread range of the Explosive Arrow is reduced while the explosion damage itself is increased.
When a player selects the upgrade for explosive spread, the spread range increases and the damage inflicted on spread targets becomes higher than that on the primary explosion target.
This change is mainly intended to highlight the advantage of "Explosive Spread" against clusters of enemies in a small area.

2. Explosive Arrow – Burning and Flame Burst  
Attacks with the Explosive Arrow inflict "Burning" on the target, which transforms into "Flame Burst" after five instances.
Since Flame Burst is overly powerful and would significantly affect the player’s willingness to choose skills,
and because Flame Burst is tied to various upgrades of Triple Shot (which can rapidly stack Flame Burst due to multiple triggers),
I have slightly reduced the damage of "Flame Burst" and increased the damage of "Burning."
This ensures that even if players do not select the "Flame Burst Mastery" or various Triple Shot upgrades, they can still benefit from the inherent attack boost of the Explosive Arrow.

3. Explosive Arrow – Meteor: Added a spreading mechanism.

4. Homing Arrow – Thunder Shield  
Although enemy damage in the game is generally low and players enjoy invincibility while casting skills,
considering that later stages may feature enemies with higher damage,
the damage reduction rate of the Thunder Shield has been greatly increased.

5. Homing Arrow – Homing Explosion  
Slightly reduced the damage per hit of the homing arrow, but increased the spread range and damage of the homing explosion.

6. Triple Shot – Lucky Strike  
Adjusted the probability of the Lucky Strike skill fully charging.

7. Lock-on Arrow – Orbital Cannon  
Since the Lock-on Arrow already deals damage across the entire map,
and because the damage from the Orbital Cannon is excessively high (originally, Level 1 could one-shot small enemies in Stage 1 and Level 2 in Stage 2),
this suppressed the appeal of other area-of-effect skills.
Therefore, the damage of the Orbital Cannon has been slightly reduced.

8. Lock-on Arrow – Thunder Spear  
Adjusted the damage of Thunder Spear itself and modified its spreading mechanism.

notes.title: Mechanism Adjustments and Buffs for Multiple Skills
notes.content:
[h1][b]Homing Arrows[/b][/h1]
The "Homing Arrows" skill has limited usage scenarios.
It excels at clearing small enemies on the battlefield,
but is nearly useless when dueling against bosses.

[b]To compensate for its lack of damage in one-on-one fights,
I have adjusted the mechanics of its two upgrades,
making it significantly more functional than other skills.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/09ebdf566f8e3ceafed6dbc216f2adf73a099f71.gif[/img]
[b]Thunder Needle and Railgun can break the shields of Lightning Arrows and Explosive Arrows.[/b]

[b]1. Homing Arrows: Thunder Needle[/b]
After Thunder Needle is placed on the ground,
it destroys the "Lightning Shield" of all enemies within its electric field (indicated by the Lightning Arrow shield icon).
It also extends the duration and attack range of Thunder Needle.

[b]2. Homing Arrows: Railgun[/b]
When Railgun hits an enemy,
it destroys their "Fire Shield" (indicated by the Explosive Arrow shield icon).
Additionally, it increases Railgun’s damage and allows it to stack "Burn" and "Explosion."

[h1][b]Triple Shot[/b][/h1]
Compared to the other three skills:
Lightning Arrows can automatically attack enemies,
Explosive Arrows have high-damage Burn and Explosion mechanics,
and Homing Arrows excel at clearing small enemies.
Triple Shot lacks these unique advantages.

Thus, besides continuous adjustments to its damage and critical hits,
this buff focuses on modifying its mechanics to make it more powerful.

[b]1. Triple Shot: Lucky Strike[/b]
Lucky Strike now has a chance to trigger "Mana Charge."
When "Mana Charge" is activated, casting Triple Shot instantly restores full mana,
allowing players to use the next skill quickly.
Additionally, Lucky Strike’s damage and critical hit rate have been increased.

[b]2. Triple Shot: Beam Arrows & Barrage Sweep[/b]
In addition to increased damage,
these two projectile variations now have the ability to stack "Burn" and "Explosion"!

[h1][b]Explosive Arrows[/b][/h1]
Explosive Arrows already feature a powerful "Explosion" mechanic:
(When a player attacks an enemy hit by Explosive Arrows,
one stack of "Burn" is applied.
At five stacks, "Explosion" triggers.
When a target is in the Explosion state,
every player attack will trigger another Explosion,
causing extremely high area-of-effect damage.
The required number of Burn stacks can be reduced by upgrading the "Explosion Mastery" skill,
allowing Explosions to trigger more quickly.)

Therefore, this update only adjusts the mechanics of the "Meteor" upgrade,
increasing its explosion radius and attack damage.

tags.balance_change: Thunder Needle and Railgun can break the shields of Lightning Arrows and Explosive Arrows.

After Thunder Needle is placed on the ground, it destroys the "Lightning Shield" of all enemies within its electric field (indicated by the Lightning Arrow shield icon). It also extends the duration and attack range of Thunder Needle.
When Railgun hits an enemy, it destroys their "Fire Shield" (indicated by the Explosive Arrow shield icon). Additionally, it increases Railgun’s damage and allows it to stack "Burn" and "Explosion."

Lucky Strike now has a chance to trigger "Mana Charge." When "Mana Charge" is activated, casting Triple Shot instantly restores full mana, allowing players to use the next skill quickly. Additionally, Lucky Strike’s damage and critical hit rate have been increased.
In addition to increased damage, these two projectile variations now have the ability to stack "Burn" and "Explosion!"
increasing its explosion radius and attack damage.

notes.title: The first version's final boss added (optional difficulty)
notes.content:
[h1]Initial Version Final Boss[/h1]
After several adjustments to the BOSS difficulty and player abilities, many players feel that the current version's difficulty is quite comfortable and allows for a smooth progression.
However, some players believe the current version is too easy.
To accommodate all players,
[b]I have decided to add the initial version of the final boss to the level for players to challenge,
but players can choose which difficulty version they want to fight[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/32361345b6a5cc8c832debb8cc9678c10bf9ea11.jpg[/img]
Choosing the route will directly adjust the BOSS difficulty.

Although this is the final boss from the initial version (game's first day),
the difficulty is not as high as it was on the first day.
This is because, while the BOSS’s battle rhythm, attack variations, and damage output have all been adjusted back to the initial version,
the player’s performance was significantly enhanced in the 2/9 update,
especially in terms of counterattacks and dodging.
So, while the BOSS has become more difficult,
the player has also become much stronger compared to the initial version.
Therefore, even if you choose the initial version of the final boss,
the difficulty won’t be as hard as it was on the first day!

[h1]BUG Fixes and Skill Adjustments[/h1]

1.Adjusted collision between player and BOSS
2.Added difficulty options in the final map of the third stage, allowing players to choose which final boss version to fight
3.Adjusted the combo thunderball tracking behavior for the BOSS in the second stage: A-grade Psionic Hunter Knight: Thunderhammer
4.Adjusted text size and positioning for the three-choice skills
5.Adjusted explosion damage after triggering Firestorm for Explosive Arrow
6.Adjusted crit chance for Lucky Strike in Triple Shot
7.Adjusted damage and crit chance for Barrage in Triple Shot
8.Adjusted damage and crit chance for Laser Arrow in Triple Shot

notes.title: Perfect Counter & Invincible Dodge
notes.content:
[h1]Perfect Counter[/h1]
Adjusted the hit detection for all "ranged" attacks from all enemies in the game.
Now, as long as a counter is successful,
there will no longer be an instance where the player counterattacks but still takes damage (a "flawed counter" state).
[b]Additionally, counter timing has been made more lenient.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743925/580c7ec81affbc020ed80947e2ee2d3f1eb9d121.gif[/img]
As shown in the image, even if the attack has completely passed through the player, they can still successfully counterattack without taking damage.

[h1]Invincible Dodge[/h1]
Adjusted the hit detection for all "melee" and "AOE" attacks from all enemies in the game.
(These are non-ranged attacks that cannot be countered.)
[b]Dodging now has invincibility frames![/b]
For attacks that cannot be countered, invincibility frames have been added.

[h1]Bug Fixes & Adjustments[/h1]

Adjusted so that player HP is fully restored after clearing a sub-stage.
Adjusted so that player HP is fully restored when switching maps.
Adjusted the attack damage of some bosses and enemies.
Fixed various bugs related to map collisions and item drops.
This update primarily improves countering and dodging mechanics.
To put it simply...
Counters are now easier to land and will no longer result in taking damage upon success.
Dodging now grants invincibility frames against attacks that cannot be countered.

notes.title: Invincibility Protection While Down and Combat Adjustments!
notes.content:
English:

[h1]Knockdown Protection[/h1]
Due to the fast-paced continuous attacks from late-game BOSSes, if a player misses a counter, subsequent attacks are typically unreactable due to the stagger effect. This update primarily addresses this issue.

Currently, there are 3 types of damage situations for players in the game:

0.2-second and 0.6-second light hits (character staggers briefly in place)
1-second knockback (character staggers with larger movements and longer stagger duration)
2-second knock-up + knockdown (character is thrown back and knocked down, with a total 2-second stagger)
Knockback and knockdown protections have now been officially added to the game! Knockback has 1 second of stagger, so it now grants 1.5 seconds of invincibility protection, while knock-up and knockdown with 2 seconds of stagger provide 2.5 seconds of knockdown protection. This change ensures that players can still respond to enemy attacks and reverse the situation even after a mistake! (The 0.2-second and 0.6-second light hits don't have invincibility protection due to their short duration, but future updates may include them; I will continue to monitor gameplay and adjust accordingly.)

[h1]Combat Adjustments[/h1]

Adjusted the model color of the S-rank Psionic Hunter Knight and resolved issues with attack indicator color tones being too similar.
S-rank Psionic Hunter Knight skill adjustments: No more massive area lightning attack when awakening from weakness.
Adjusted the bullet flight speed of Elite Enemy 2-3 Strawman Musketeers.
Adjusted the attack range detection for the 2-2 Elite Enemy Giant Statue's ground slam.
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Fixed the issue where potions reset to zero in New Game+ mode.
Fixed a problem with map drop probabilities during phase transitions in the Final Boss battle.
[h1]Reward Changes[/h1]
Defeating the Final Boss now directly grants a choice of a legendary skill!

notes.content:

Adjusted the double throwing dagger counterattack to fix an issue where one dagger would hit the other. Now, both daggers will be judged for counterattack simultaneously.
Removed the lingering lightning damage effect on the ground after the Phase 2 dash.

Additionally, many players provided bug reports and game suggestions on the first day,
and I am still actively fixing and addressing these issues!
A huge thank you to all the players who joined on launch day!
I sincerely apologize if you encountered any bugs,
and I will do my best to fix them!

After this update, the difficulty curve of the game should feel more reasonable and smoother,
especially addressing the sudden difficulty spike from 2-5 onward.
Furthermore, adjustments to the inner and outer ring mechanics should make it easier for players to identify safe zones.

notes.title: DEMO Version Update
notes.content:
"Psionic Sentry: Infinite" is launching its Early Access version soon!

The latest DEMO update includes the following changes:

Controller Button Layout Adjustments
Based on feedback from the demo version and multiple exhibitions,
we have temporarily adjusted the button layout to better match player preferences.

Invincibility During Skill Casting
Normal attacks can be canceled with counters/dodges, preventing situations
where players "see" an enemy attack but are unable to react due to attack animations.
However, skill casting has unavoidable end-lag, often causing such issues.
To address this, we’ve introduced a new mechanic: "Invincibility During Skill Casting",
ensuring smoother combat flow and encouraging players to use skills more frequently.

Korean Translation Added
Our backend data shows a significant number of Korean players, so we have added Korean language support.

Resolution Support

4K resolution support added
Ultra-wide 21:9 resolution support added
Enemy Adjustments
Tweaked the abilities and stats of certain elite enemies.

This update ensures that the DEMO version aligns with the upcoming Early Access Level 1 content.
The Early Access version of "Psionic Sentry: Infinite" is coming very soon!
We appreciate your support and look forward to your feedback!
